lead.name: ssn-1l-tag
lead.source: pouw_space.toml at N-CARD's f697396586 (cursor/compute-research-np-card-7c2d): ssn-1l-tag's S = 1 + ceil((K - 28)/31) steps and S - 1 + c coin bits a row in whole 32-bit coin words (ssn-1l-hw's S + 15 fill the same words at Llama's K), B' lane 31 a public weight lane; T1 0.000% credited, 0.420% with the coins' XOF hashing uncredited (NIGHT.md section 7)

layouts.source: blc1a: the coin on its own lane (lane 30) against a constant A' = 1, beside the lead's row-bit lane 31, at 30 data lanes a later step: its served noise sum_t s_t[tile, j] is a column term, folded by N-EXACT's IADD3 column source with the per-tile column vector streamed by the certifier (4 bytes a tile and column), or the coin itself where a tile carries coins in one step; the constant lane is static in A's layout (no forming, estimate). blc4a: three such coin lanes (28-30) beside the row lane 31, at 28 data lanes, one 4-byte cp.async a (tile, step, column) carrying the three coins and lane 31's public weight, no register written, served exactly by the same fold. B-lane coins: the B' noise lane of every later k32 step holds a nonzero coin value per (row tile, step, column), odd in +-(2^e - 1), streamed raw by the certifier; one lane (blc1, the lead's own lane) is patched into the B tile in shared memory by one 32-bit load a 4 coin bytes and four byte stores; four lanes (blc4, lanes 28-31) take a 4-byte cp.async a column a step, no register written, at 28 data lanes a step. A wgmma's B tile is shared by the CTA tile's rows (64 a warpgroup, 128 for two), so a coin entry is shared by them; a tile with r < T rows carries coins in ceil((S - 1) r / T) of its later steps, spread evenly, and the lead's public lane in the rest. C-init: an accumulator-init coin an output element, e = ceil(K / n_target) bits

prices.source: W1 at H32 (a register write 32 units, a MAC 1); the hashing credit at ShaLB's 3,632 registers a 128-byte compression (the alt_roads floor, 908 units a byte) and N-SHALB's 3,532 for chained compressions (NIGHT.md section 7); answers: DitherInstance's W_mac bounds W_mm + W_sha + W_ans, the selected blocks' answers at full weight, which N-CARD prices at none (0 here, a lower estimate); byte stores into shared memory are unpriced in W1 and timed at one a lane a SM-clock (estimate)

outsource.source: The outsourcing provers under R1b: the prover keeps A_j for the certifier, so it computes the served path itself and an outside machine computes the coin-dependent words and their hashing, returning one 512-bit root a call. With a coin-free served path (the de-noised lead, blc1a) the outside machine rebuilds the activations from the 32-bit token and takes any set of call types; with a noisy one it needs the coins of every earlier call (a prefix of the forward). The cap's slack is the cap less the honest's own traffic, one 17-bit Llama-3 token id a token (128,256 ids, in for prefill or out for decode; estimate)

certifier.source: SHA-512 counter-mode coins on one AMD EPYC Genoa core (runs r20261029-074951-e66c and r20261029-075358-9963)
